"""KinDER instance i00 robot control record. Actions are sent only through rcb_client."""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()

def status():
    return r.status()

def observe(cameras=None, depth=False):
    return r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth)

def step(rows, cameras=None, video="none", depth=False, note=""):
    return r.submit("delta", np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1, 11),
                    cameras=cameras, video=video, include_depth=depth, note=note)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(r.spec())
    print(r.status())
